Check the approved identity-provider/service status and, where relevant, the reader, certificate, time synchronization, or multi-factor enrollment state.
Retry only through the normal sign-in or account-recovery workflow and capture the exact error and timestamp.

verification: Verify the original symptom is resolved in the authorized system, confirm the related record/device/status is consistent, and document the final result or escalation reference.
